source.text: Lucinda Shen / Axios : Sources: a16z is in talks to raise ~$20B across its next set of funds; its last set, announced in January at $15B+, later grew to $20B+ with three add-ons — Venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz is in talks to raise about $20 billion across its next set of funds, Axios Pro has learned from three sources familiar.

draft.headline: Andreessen Horowitz is in talks to raise about $20 billion across its next set of funds.
draft.threads_post:
Venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz is in talks to raise about $20 billion for its next set of funds, according to Axios sources.

Its previous set of funds was announced in January at $15B+. That total later expanded to over $20B after adding three extra funds.

Are mega-funds over $20B good or bad for the tech startup ecosystem?
